nativeRoute: LingXing docs-site access session + NocoDB API token (two independent systems)

loginFlow.steps: 先复用合法文档浏览器 session 与 NOCODB_TOKEN；文档站缺访问权限时由用户通过实际网页入口/平台 owner 申请，不能复制旧 SKILL 硬编码 Access Key。NocoDB 原生登录后 API Tokens 页面申请最小权限。
loginFlow.authorization: Login, token creation/rotation/revocation and business writes require the current task scope; this discovery performs none.

tokenMechanism: 文档站 Cookie access mechanism 的发行/expiry 尚未确认；NocoDB xc-token。此 skill 录入路径配置，不直接申请 ERP 业务 app secret。
subjectPermission: 文档 sidebar/目标 markdown 可读，NocoDB AmazonApi.lingxing 目标表只读去重；两者分别验证，不假设共享身份。
expiryRevoke: 文档 key 撤销入口待厂商明确；NocoDB Token 页面 revoke。录入仅允许读取类 API 配置，写配置仍按 owner 门禁。

versionPolicy.rule: Candidate source and published contracts do not establish deployed compatibility. Verify the target instance version and read-only supported capabilities before enabling an adapter.

verification.scope: Read-only documentation/repository discovery; no login, token issuance, credential inspection or business API execution.
